summary.name: SheetGod
summary.one_liner: SheetGod is an AI-powered tool that generates Excel formulas, VBA macros, regular expressions, and Google Apps Script snippets from plain-English questions.
use_cases: Writing Excel formulas from a plain-English description
Generating VBA macros to automate Excel tasks
Creating Google Apps Script snippets for Google Sheets
Building regular expressions to extract data from text
Sending marketing emails or generating bulk PDFs from spreadsheet data
summary.what_it_does: SheetGod lets you pick a category (Formulas, VBA, Regex, Appscript, or Basic Tasks), type a question in plain English, and receive an AI-generated answer to use directly. It generates Excel formulas, macros, regular expressions, and Google Apps Script code for automating spreadsheet work. The page also says it provides step-by-step tutorials for basic Excel and Google Sheets tasks. It mentions use for sending marketing emails, generating bulk PDFs, and creating Google Workspace Add-Ons and Microsoft Excel Add-Ins.
notable: Covers formulas, VBA, regex, Apps Script, and basic task tutorials in one tool
Offers 1-1 Zoom and WhatsApp onboarding and a 30-day money-back guarantee
caveats: Listed as paid; the page does not state specific prices or plan tiers
Meta description calls the Excel Formulas Generator free, which conflicts with the paid listing; pricing details are unclear
